## Wave 4 Summary

Two independent computes that close the residual **magnitude-openness** questions left by two prior workshops, neither a Planck-comparison gate:

- **W4-1 (`CF-S114-AS-FUNCTIONAL-SELECTION`, transit-dynamics-theorist)** — the A_s **Object-2** decider. The S113 WS-5 AS-HTILDE workshop converged to a clean two-object split: the floor-amplitude POINT (`A_s_FW = 1.5367e-08`) is SET by the TD impulse-quench source (Object 1, settled, H̃-independent at the scale-origin); the magnitude-as-a-Planck-comparison-NUMBER is OPEN (Object 2 — three defensible functionals span **1.2590 OOM**, none in Planck's ±5% band). This gate runs the single decisive compute the workshop left behind: does the substrate's own structure SELECT one spectral functional for the produced-relic amplitude, or is functional-choice a genuine physical d.o.f. (the lizzi-signature)? The decisive sub-test is whether the fold-transit conformal pump barrier `aH|_fold = 0.975 M_KK` carries the 181× SDW/Zubarev `a_0/a_2` split. A FAIL here is INFORMATIVE — it PINS the A_s magnitude as a physical d.o.f. like the CC ratio (converting §EVOI.BF from "open, may converge" to "open, structurally").

- **W4-2 (`CF-S113-B5A-TFD`, hawking-theorist)** — the surviving white-hole microstate route, **Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING**. The S112 B5A-BRACKETED verdict bracketed the exit-slice microstate ratio in `[0.5263 (edge undershoot), 1.382 (full island overshoot)]`; A/4 sits between, unreached by the single-sided causal patch (which lands R≈0.53). The two-sided thermofield-double (TFD) island construction is the surviving route. Test the TFD microstate count against the emergent area-law `A_horizon_FW/4`.

**Carry-forward source**: the S113 EVOI-frontier workshop-campaign synthesis §3 #7 (WS-5 AS-HTILDE verdict §5) for W4-1; `session-112-w3-workingpaper.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (the lone S112 WP carry-forward) for W4-2. Both are COMPUTE-class.

Neither W4 gate depends on any other S114 wave's verdict. Both consume ONLY on-disk static inputs (S100b box-delta npz; S111 island npz; canonical_constants.py; S82 Obs-6.3 SDW/Zubarev split values cited as literals). method:

    Re-compute the white-hole exit-slice microstate count via a TWO-SIDED thermofield-double (TFD)
    island construction — the surviving route after the single-sided exit slice undershot to the edge
    (R_edge = 0.5263, S110) and the full island overshot (R_island = 1.382, S111); A/4 = A_quarter
    sits between, unreached by either single-sided bracket endpoint. The TFD doubling: the white-hole
    exit slice has a thermofield-double purification partner (the two-sided eternal-black-hole /
    eternal-white-hole geometry); the island region I extends across BOTH sides of the TFD, so the
    causally-accessible bulk-EE fraction f_bulk^TFD is set by the TWO-SIDED causal patch on the exit
    slice (the union of the two sub-Mach cones across the TFD partner), NOT the single-sided
    inverse-Mach patch (1/M = 1/13.75 = 60/15237 nats, the S112 single-sided result). Load the L12
    GGE bulk-EE profile (s111_b5a_island.npz: lambda_grid, sbulk_grid, S_bulk_total = 180723.4) and the
    A/4 anchor (A_quarter = A_horizon_FW/4 = 17806.566). Compute the TFD-accessible bulk-EE fraction
    f_bulk^TFD from the two-sided causal structure (DERIVED from the TFD geometry, NOT tuned to hit
    A/4), then R_TFD = [Area(∂I_TFD)/4 + f_bulk^TFD·S_bulk-EE(I)] / A_quarter. ANTI-TAUTOLOGY: the
    R_TFD = 1 crossing is FORBIDDEN as the canonical f_bulk^TFD (per the S112 B5A-BRACKETED precedent,
    which recorded the R=1 crossing at f* = 0.5536 as the FORBIDDEN tautology point); the R=1 crossing
    is computed DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY and reported as the forbidden line, never as the verdict source.
  producing_script: "computations/session-114/s114_cf_b5a_tfd.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "ratio"
  form: "|R_TFD − 1| ?<= τ, where R_TFD = [Area(∂I_TFD)/4 + f_bulk^TFD·S_bulk-EE(I)] / A_quarter"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "0.10"
  direction: "<="     # |R_TFD − 1| <= 0.10 PASS; (0.10, 0.25] INFO; > 0.25 FAIL

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically — the bands are the standard B5A 3-band; f_bulk^TFD is derived,
#     not analytic, but the R_TFD interpolant is closed-form once f_bulk^TFD is fixed.
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "R_TFD = R_edge + f_bulk^TFD·(R_island − R_edge) is the closed-form interpolant between the two pinned bracket endpoints (R_edge = 0.5263, R_island = 1.382, both npz-loaded); given f_bulk^TFD the band membership is exact. The 3-band (0.10/0.25) is the pre-registered B5A standard (matches S112 B5A-BRACKETED + S111 B5A-ISLAND PASS_TOL/INFO_TOL)."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous — f_bulk^TFD ∈ [0,1] continuous; the PASS band on f_bulk^TFD is the pre-image of |R_TFD − 1| ≤ 0.10 under the linear interpolant"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "lambda_grid length from s111_b5a_island.npz (the L12 GGE bulk-EE profile, fixed; no rebuild)"
  L_max: "12 (the S111 L12 island bulk-EE profile is reused verbatim; no new D_K diagonalization)"
  scan_range: "N/A — f_bulk^TFD is DERIVED from the two-sided TFD causal geometry, not scanned; the R=1 crossing is a single diagnostic point, not a scan"
  step_size: "N/A — deterministic"
  tolerance: "PASS 0.10, INFO 0.25 (|R_TFD − 1| bands); 1e-9 (A_quarter = A_horizon_FW/4 rel-match cross-check)"
  scheme: "TFD-ISLAND-TWO-SIDED-MICROSTATE-COUNT (the two-sided thermofield-double island construction; successor to the S112 single-sided QES-island-bracketed-interpolation)"
  convention: "RATIO-DERIVED-TFD-CAUSAL-PATCH-FRACTION (f_bulk^TFD derived from the two-sided causal structure; R_TFD = ratio to A_quarter; anti-tautology: R=1 crossing diagnostic-only)"
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg (the bulk-EE profile is a pre-computed 1D array; cumulative-sum + interpolant are scalar/vector ops — CPU; the L12 bulk-EE cross-check reuses the S111 profile, no fresh eigensolve)"
  # CONDITIONAL pins (declared because they apply):
  regulator_pin: "c_conical = 0.2500001250001146 = a_2^{Pauli-Villars} (the conical 2nd Seeley-DeWitt moment; the Area(∂I)/4 boundary-term normalization). Pole/grading: a_2 = n=2 Einstein-Hilbert moment, Pauli-Villars-regulated (NOT zeta) — this is the replica-trick conical-deficit normalization, distinct from the a_2_FW_zeta spectral-action moment. Source: inv4_w1_euclidean_replica.npz, also stored in s111_b5a_island.npz (c_conical key)."

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([SIGN] trigger: dR_TFD/df_bulk > 0).
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "R_TFD is strictly increasing in the TFD-accessible bulk-EE fraction f_bulk^TFD:
    dR_TFD/df_bulk = R_island − R_edge > 0; the two-sided TFD patch raises f_bulk above the
    single-sided 0.00396, pushing R_TFD up from the edge undershoot toward A/4."

    Step 1 — Definitions:
      R_edge   = S_boundary/(A/4) = 0.5263227104145511      [S111 npz R_edge_S110; lower bracket,
                                                             bulk-EE OMITTED, edge-only undershoot]
      R_island = [Area(∂I)/4 + S_bulk-EE(I)]/(A/4) = 1.3820022088029909
                                                             [S111 npz R_island; upper bracket,
                                                             FULL island bulk-EE, overshoot]
      A_quarter = A_horizon_FW/4 = 71226.26338976152/4 = 17806.56584744038   [S111 npz A_quarter;
                                                             emergent a_2 area-law, CC2 anchor]
      S_bulk-EE(I) = S_bulk_total = 180723.41563481884      [S111 npz; the L12 GGE island bulk-EE]
      f_bulk^TFD = S_bulk-EE(I_acc^TFD)/S_bulk-EE(I)         [the TWO-SIDED causally-accessible fraction;
                                                             DERIVED from the TFD geometry, NOT tuned]

    Step 2 — Substitution (the microstate-count interpolant; no simplification):
      R_TFD(f) = R_edge + f·(R_island − R_edge)              [the same bracket interpolant the S112
                                                             B5A-BRACKETED gate used, now with the
                                                             two-sided f_bulk^TFD in place of the
                                                             single-sided 0.00396]

    Step 3 — Simplify (one step per line):
      dR_TFD/df = R_island − R_edge
                = 1.3820022088029909 − 0.5263227104145511
                = 0.8556794983884398

    Step 4 — Direction read-off (from canonical form):
      dR_TFD/df = +0.8557 > 0  ⇒  R_TFD strictly increasing in f_bulk^TFD.
      Consistent with the S112 sign=PASS (dR/df_bulk = +0.8557 > 0) and both prior B5A verdicts'
      sign=PASS. The two-sided TFD patch makes MORE bulk-EE causally accessible than the single-sided
      patch (f_bulk^TFD > f_bulk^single = 0.00396), so R_TFD > R(0.00396) = 0.5297 — the SIGN of the
      correction is gap-closing (toward A/4). [sign_verdict = PASS iff the computed dR_TFD/df > 0.]
      Whether the magnitude reaches the PASS band |R_TFD − 1| ≤ 0.10 depends on how much of the island
      bulk-EE the two-sided causal patch admits — that is the gate's open magnitude question.

    Step 5 — ANTI-TAUTOLOGY fence (FORBIDDEN crossing, diagnostic-only):
      Setting R_TFD(f*) = 1 ⇒ f* = (1 − R_edge)/(R_island − R_edge) = (1 − 0.5263)/0.8557 = 0.5536
      This f* = 0.5536 is the FORBIDDEN tautology crossing (the f_bulk^TFD that would hit A/4 BY
      CONSTRUCTION). It is computed DIAGNOSTIC-ONLY and reported as the forbidden line; the canonical
      f_bulk^TFD MUST be the substrate-DERIVED two-sided fraction, NEVER f* = 0.5536. (Per the S112
      B5A-BRACKETED precedent, which recorded exactly this crossing as FORBIDDEN.)

    Conclusion: dR_TFD/df_bulk = +0.8557 > 0 (sign PASS, gap-closing); the magnitude verdict is the
                pre-registered open question (PASS/INFO/FAIL by |R_TFD − 1| bands); the R=1 crossing
                f* = 0.5536 is FORBIDDEN as canonical (diagnostic-only).

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  |R_TFD − 1| ≤ 0.10. The two-sided TFD island construction makes enough of the GGE island bulk-EE
  causally accessible that the microstate count lands at the emergent area-law A_horizon_FW/4 within
  10%. In solution space: the white-hole exit-slice microstate count = A/4 corridor SURVIVES via the
  two-sided TFD route (where the single-sided causal patch failed at R≈0.53, S112) — a positive
  internal-consistency result for the emergent-area-law (a_2 second-moment) microstate accounting.
  Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING: PASS does NOT alter any observational falsifier row.
FAIL_meaning: >
  |R_TFD − 1| > 0.25. Even the two-sided TFD doubling does not make enough island bulk-EE causally
  accessible on the exit slice to reach A/4 — the Mach-13.75 white-hole causal patch is too narrow
  even when doubled across the TFD partner. In solution space: the "microstate count = A/4 via a
  causally-derived bulk-EE fraction" corridor CLOSES on both the single-sided (S112) and two-sided
  routes; the A/4 microstate accounting would require a different (non-causal-patch) mechanism. NOT a
  defeat — a closed corridor in the white-hole microstate map. Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING.
INFO_meaning: >
  0.10 < |R_TFD − 1| ≤ 0.25. The two-sided TFD route brings the microstate count substantially closer
  to A/4 than the single-sided patch (which gave |R−1| = 0.470) but does not reach the 10% PASS band.
  In solution space: the two-sided route is the RIGHT direction (the corridor narrows) but the
  magnitude is marginal — a future refinement (e.g. the full two-sided island QES extremization rather
  than the linear bracket interpolant) is the forward object. Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING.

## Wave 4 → Wave 5 Decision Point

Wave 4 is the LAST wave of Session 114 (per the plan index: W1–W4). Neither W4 gate feeds a downstream S114 wave. The forward routing of each verdict:

- **W4-1 (`CF-S114-AS-FUNCTIONAL-SELECTION`)**:
  - **PASS (SELECTED)** → the capstone A_s conditional down-tag is RETIRED (a designated-writer patch: A_s becomes a typed one-functional prediction); `mack-cosmic-bridge` updates falsifier-master-inventory Row #12 (A_s) from SCHEME-DEPENDENT to the single selected functional; the §EVOI.BF liability drops A_s.
  - **FAIL (PLURALISM-PERMANENT)** → the capstone A_s conditional down-tag LANDS as "magnitude open, structurally — a physical d.o.f. like the CC ratio" (designated-writer patch); `mack-cosmic-bridge` updates Row #12 / §EVOI.BF to "open, structurally" (the >3-OOM liability re-localized to cross-functional + exit-greybody-filter openness). This is the informative-FAIL outcome the WS-5 verdict pre-flagged.
  - **INFO (partial / regime-conditional)** → the down-tag is HELD pending a regime-resolved follow-up; a 4-field carry-forward (`CF-S115-AS-FUNCTIONAL-REGIME`) is emitted in the WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` block.
  - In ALL cases the §7 falsifier-surface / Row #12 edit is `mack-cosmic-bridge`'s sole-writer domain (`feedback_mack-bridge-role.md`); the capstone A_s prose tag is the designated-writer's domain (capstone-hygiene-gate Q3, routed to `session-114-housekeeping.md`).

- **W4-2 (`CF-S113-B5A-TFD`)**: Tier-3 NON-BLOCKING. NO downstream gate, NO falsifier-surface row (the microstate count is an internal-consistency corridor-narrowing compute, not an observational falsifier).
  - **PASS** → the white-hole microstate = A/4 corridor survives via the two-sided TFD route; atlas-09 white-hole entry gains the two-sided-TFD-A/4 confirmation; no down-tag.
  - **FAIL** → the A/4-via-causal-patch corridor closes on both single-sided and two-sided routes; recorded as a closed corridor in the white-hole microstate map (Constraint-Map Update).
  - **INFO** → the two-sided route narrows the corridor but is marginal; a 4-field carry-forward (`CF-S115-B5A-TFD-QES`, the full two-sided island QES extremization vs the linear bracket interpolant) is emitted in the WP `## Carry-Forward Computations` block.
